entries.title: Module 1 — What Is a Soul Tie?
entries.text: A soul tie is a deep spiritual and emotional bond that joins two people at the level of mind, will, emotion and sometimes spirit. Pastor Kiky opened the teaching with a definition, because a thing that is not named cannot be broken. A soul tie is a deep connection between two people that links their mind, links their will, links their emotion, and sometimes even their spirits. It is a spiritual and emotional bond that connects two people together. That is why a person can date somebody, and after the breakup their life has never remained the same again. The relationship ended physically, but the bond did not end with it. What makes a soul tie ungodly An ungodly soul tie is an agreement between two or more people bound together by lust, bound together by evil powers, bound together by monitoring spirits. Pastor Kiky called it a demonic covenant between a man and a woman. It is the reason some people say, “there is a spirit following me; there is a shadow lying next to me in bed.” Many people are praying, many people are fasting, many people are believing God for freedom — yet they remain bound. Not because God has not answered their prayers, but because there is an ungodly soul tie still connecting them to people, to past relationships and to spiritual influences. Why this teaching matters Ungodly soul ties are some of the reasons why a person has not progressed. Some of the reasons why they cannot move forward. Some of the reasons why they are tormented. Some of the reasons why prosperity is not coming. They have to be dealt with — and the word of the Lord says they can be.

entries.title: Module 2 — Godly vs Ungodly Soul Ties
entries.text: Not all soul ties are evil. God ordains bonds that build, open doors and elevate — and the pattern of the godly bond exposes the counterfeit. Not all soul ties are evil. There are good ones. God-ordained healthy soul ties are also there — between husband and wife, between parents and their children, between believers and Christ. Those are good soul ties. There are soul ties that help you build. There are soul ties that open doors. There are soul ties that elevate you in life. Attaching yourself with godly soul ties builds you up. It helps you. It opens doors. It elevates you. But when a connection is formed outside the will of God — or through sin, through trauma, through manipulation or demonic influence — it becomes an ungodly soul tie. It can hold a person in captivity. The marriage pattern: one flesh Genesis 2:24 shows the godly pattern. They shall be — what? — one flesh. This is a godly soul tie. You become one with the person, you connect with the person: an emotional bond, a spiritual bond. This shows that relationships create real spiritual connections. The friendship pattern: knit souls The soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David. They had a bond; they had a soul tie. It was a friendship soul tie. So soul ties are real. And they are powerful. That same power runs the other way. When you are friends with a witch, it will not be long before you become a witch. If you are friends with a marine agent, it will not be long; you will be initiated into it; you will become one. It says, “Show me your friend and I will show you your character.” Even ordinary friends — when you are very close to them, there are some friends you become so close to, you become like twins. You do everything together. They have a soul tie. You can become close friends with somebody — you think, “just friends,” “close friends” — and your things begin to be destroyed, because whatever was following them now starts to follow you. The strongest tie of all The most important soul tie is the one that God Himself offers: he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit. Every other bond in a believer's life is measured against that one.

entries.title: Module 3 — How Ungodly Soul Ties Are Formed
entries.text: Five doorways named in the teaching: sexual sin outside God's will, toxic and abusive relationships, past relationships never released, trauma and deep emotional bonds, and covenants and spiritual agreements. Pastor Kiky answered the question the room was asking: how did I get here? How did this ungodly soul tie form in my life? What did I do for me to be in this kind of soul tie? He named five doorways. (a) Sexual relationships outside the will of God Some sexual relationships outside the will of God can form a soul tie. Sex is not just physical; it is spiritual. Some sexual contact is not sexually transmitted disease, but sexually transmitted demons. Consider someone having sexual relations with a satanic agent, a marine agent, a wizard — somebody who, when you wrong them, they will kill you. That contact causes things to be exchanged. It causes a bond between the two of them. Now there is a bond with somebody who is always going to witch doctors to do spiritual things against other people. It will not just end when the relationship is ended. They will be your pain spiritually also. They have left you physically, but spiritually they will follow you. Spiritually they will hinder every man or every woman who wants to come anywhere close to you. Spiritually they will make sure an entity follows you. If they are agents of the devil, they can spiritually manipulate your life, spiritually control your life, spiritually visit you, and follow you wherever you go. So a person suffers attack after attack. Shadows follow them. Presences have sexual contact with them. Things are after their life — after that relationship, after that sexual contact with that strange woman, with that strange man. There was a soul tie, and he would deal with them through the soul tie. He knows he is one flesh with them. So he can destroy their potential, take their abilities, redirect their steps, and separate them from anyone that is coming to them. For years after a divorce, for years after a breakup, they have not met anyone. This also means you can carry what is in the other person. You can inherit struggles. You can inherit emotions. You can inherit spiritual bondages. You can inherit negative things. There are people who start going out with a thief, and all of a sudden they also become a thief. Some who marry occultic men get to the point that they join. You become — what? — one flesh. (b) Toxic and abusive relationships Relationships marked by control, marked by manipulation, emotional dependency and fear. These create unhealthy attachments that are difficult to break. You might ask the woman, “Why are you still with this man that beats you? Your eyes are always swollen. You are still sitting there being manipulated, being controlled, being abused. You sit in fear every day of your life.” And they cannot leave. Why? Because she is one flesh with the man. She is suffering, but she stays. She stays because the soul tie has made her emotionally dependent on him, controlled, manipulated. He says, “I have beaten you. I don't know what came over me.” And then he is forgiven. And she continues to stay. The principle stands: an ungodly soul tie will keep a person inside a relationship that is destroying them. That bond will not be talked out of them — it must be broken by prayer, by the blood of Jesus, and by the power of the Holy Ghost. (c) Past relationships that were never released Some people have left physically, but are still connected emotionally and spiritually in ungodly soul ties. Some are not in the relationship — some have even moved on with somebody else — but they are still talking and thinking about that past relationship. Sometimes the person has left, but with the new one, they must imagine and think of that old one before they can even have contact with the new one. It gets to the point that if the old one calls in that moment, they leave this one and go to that one, and come back. It is so tight; it is very unhealthy. This is what causes a lot of heartbreak. A person is heartbroken. They cannot eat. They cannot speak. They are not themselves for one week, because they are still spiritually and emotionally attached to this person. It takes prayers, deliverance and a whole lot more to detach them so that they can move on with life. (d) Trauma and deep emotional bonds Painful experience can tie you to people or to moments that continue to influence your life. It can tie you with certain people. (e) Covenants and spiritual agreements Some soul ties are strengthened by words spoken. Some are strengthened by a promise that is made. Some are strengthened by ritual, by ungodly dedications. Some relationships have certain covenants; they go deeper — not just the sex. They can do blood covenants. They can do things in agreement that will keep their bond going. They can swear to other things. People get into relationships and do some crazy things together, and then in the end they break up. And when they break up, the ungodly soul tie starts to wake.

entries.title: Module 4 — Signs an Ungodly Soul Tie Is Operating
entries.text: The nine signs Pastor Kiky listed for the room — the symptoms that reveal something deeper is at work. When a person is tied and connected emotionally, and an ungodly soul tie is operating in their life, these are the signs Pastor Kiky named: You cannot stop thinking about the other person. You are always, every day, every second thinking about the other person — what they are eating, what they are drinking, where they are travelling to, what they have. Sometimes you become a stalker. It is because of the soul tie. You cannot stop thinking about them, even though they are not in your life anymore. You feel spiritually and emotionally drained. You keep returning to a toxic relationship. The person beats you, maltreats you, makes you feel worthless, disgraces you, insults your food and insults your being and calls you ugly. They do everything. You have packed your things and left — but by one word you have returned to the same toxic relationship. This toxic relationship that debases you all the time, where the person cheats on you with all kinds of people — and you return to it so easily. You experience repeated dreams about the person. You feel controlled. You feel manipulated. You feel bound. You feel distressed. You feel that there is an attack in your life. You experience spiritual sexual attack in dreams — somebody projected to come and have sex with you at midnight. You feel them, and the monitoring spirit that is monitoring your every move, that is after everything you do. You struggle to move forward in your life and in any other relationship. You feel guilty. You feel confused. You feel oppressed. You feel fear without a clear reason. These are not ordinary. They are signs that something deeper is at work in a life, and that deliverance is needed — a touch of the Lord in the life and in the destiny, by the power of the Holy Ghost. Revelation comes before deliverance Pastor Kiky closed the service on this note: lack of knowledge makes God's people perish. There are hidden things we do not know that are fighting our life. Sometimes when we are focusing on something else, it may be that particular thing the Lord wants to reveal, so that we can pray against it. There are contacts we have — friendships, relationships — that are disturbing our progress and our moving forward, and we do not know. These prayers and topics reveal what we are really going through.

entries.title: Module 5 — What Ungodly Soul Ties Do
entries.text: Delay, blockage, pollution, demonic doors, transferred burdens — and the pattern of Samson, whose strength went from him through a wrong connection. An ungodly soul tie can delay your destiny. It can delay your progress. It can block your blessing. It can pollute your spiritual life — you are not able to pray like you used to. It opens demonic doors in your life. It affects your decision making, even in relationships. It transfers burdens, it transfers struggles, it transfers demons, it transfers ungodly spirits to operate in your life. What it takes from a person Some of it takes your confidence. You used to dress and look so beautiful, and now you don't do your hair. You don't dress. You have become miserable. You stay in the dark in your room. You don't want to do anything or go anywhere. You have become depressed. Heaviness is upon your life, complaining about everything every day. You are lost. That relationship has left you and drained everything out of you because of the ungodly soul tie. And most of the time there are a lot of things going on in your life that you do not even understand. Some ungodly soul ties took a destiny. It took a potential. It took the woman someone was supposed to be, the man someone was supposed to be. It took confidence away. Samson and Delilah That is why Samson lost his strength through Delilah. He loved that girl, but after that relationship he lost his strength. He lost his ability. He lost his destiny. There was a plan of God upon his life. He had an assignment with God — but after that demonic relationship, he was not as he was supposed to be. Pastor Kiky put the question to the room: who was the Delilah that this ungodly tie came from, and has left you the way you are? That is why wrong connections can destroy great destinies. A lot of destinies have been destroyed because of wrong connections. Words spoken over a life Even the words spoken in the past still trigger a person today. Some of the things said to you, you live with them like they are still new. You still believe those words, and you have no confidence. “Your food is not nice” — so any time you cook, you think the food is not nice. And maybe your food is the most delicious food ever, but you do not know it. They have disgraced your image, so when you go out you cannot even show your face too much, because in your mind what you have been told still dwells and lives with you. It is not true. Be delivered. Let your identity be restored.

entries.title: Module 6 — Freedom Through the Son
entries.text: The good news of the teaching: Jesus did not only come to forgive sins — He came to break every bondage, and God has declared the covenant with death disannulled. You see, the good news is Jesus. Jesus did not only come to forgive sins; He came to break every bondage in our life and in our destiny. Every ungodly connection must bow to the power of the Holy Ghost. Every ungodly connection must bow to the power of the cross of Calvary. The covenant with death is disannulled Isaiah 28:18 is the main scripture of this teaching. It says, “Your covenant with death shall be disannulled.” Some — or all — of your ungodly soul ties are covenants with death, because some of these ties destroy your life, mislead you, and take your original glory and your potential from your life. And your covenant with death shall be — what? — disannulled. He says, “And your agreement with hell.” Some of the ungodly soul ties are agreements with hell. He says, “It shall not stand,” by the power of the Holy Ghost. The legal ground: the finished work of Christ Galatians 3:13-14 gives the ground on which every ungodly covenant is broken. Christ was made a curse for us, redeeming us from the curse of the law, so that the blessing of Abraham might come and we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith. The believer does not break covenants by their own strength or by any object; they break them by standing on what Christ has already finished. Today is your day of freedom Pastor Kiky called the room into freedom: Freedom from past relationships Freedom from the sexual encounters you had Freedom from toxic relationships Freedom from toxic friendship Freedom from manipulation and control Freedom from trauma and pain Freedom from spiritual covenants — they must break by faith. Break by fire! You are not bound. You are not owned by anybody but God. You are not supposed to be controlled. You belong to Jesus Christ of Nazareth, by the power of the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Module 7 — Seven Steps to Break Ungodly Soul Ties
entries.text: Repent · renounce and denounce out loud · apply the blood · cut emotional and spiritual access · remove the objects · fill the void with the Holy Ghost · be joined to Christ. Pastor Kiky gave the room a way — seven steps, in order. Step 1 — Repentance The first thing is repentance. Some of these ungodly ties were formed with people with whom there was something wrong: a satanic agent, a marine agent, a water spirit; somebody occultic, somebody always visiting witch doctors and doing spiritual negativity. And after they left, something is wrong. So when you want to deliver yourself from an ungodly soul tie, you first repent. Repent for any involvement. It sounds like this: “I did not know this man very well. I did not know what he was doing — but Lord, I was attached to him. I did not know this woman very well, but Lord, I was attached to her. Lord, deliver me. I repent of every sin.” Step 2 — Renounce and denounce every connection You have to be able to renounce every connection. You must speak out. Your freedom is voice-activated. That is why declaring matters. Most of the time in deliverance, when you are declaring, when you are renouncing and denouncing, the demons manifest and leave — when you begin to speak, when you begin to rebuke by the power of the Holy Ghost. Write on a paper everyone with whom you feel there is an ungodly soul tie — it can be a male or a female. Begin to renounce that friendship. Begin to renounce that connection. Begin to renounce: “I was with you, but now I am not part of you, in the name of Jesus. And the connection I had with you, I renounce it. I denounce it. I am now a child of God. I am connected to Jesus. Whatever I had with you that was in my past — whatever you did in the name of Jesus that has kept a connection, that has kept a bond — today I destroy that bond. Today I destroy any covenant between you and I, in the mighty name of Jesus.” Step 3 — Use the blood of Jesus Christ of Nazareth The blood disconnects you from every ungodly covenant, because the blood speaks of a new covenant. Where sexual contact formed a covenant, Jesus, through the blood, disconnects you from it. There are ungodly soul ties that are only friendship connections; and there are ungodly soul ties formed through sexual contact — and that is a covenant. When you have sexual contact with anybody, you have formed a covenant. Step 4 — Cut emotional and spiritual access Cut emotional and spiritual access. Cut it! If you want to be delivered, cut that emotional and spiritual access. Stop communication if necessary with this person — this toxic person who has disgraced you before, who has manipulated you, beaten you. Because sometimes there was a heartbreak too. This person broke your heart so much. But this same person still controls you. Whatever they tell you to do, you do. You do not know why you are doing it, but you do it anyway. You know this person might hurt you again, but you follow them again. Step 5 — Remove anything that keeps that connection alive, and guard your heart Some people keep a set of clothes, dresses, underwear under their pillow. The person has left, broken their heart, done everything wrong, and they still keep his shirt because it keeps them attached. It is not a good thing; it is an emotional and spiritual asset. Remove anything that keeps that connection alive, and guard your heart. Step 6 — Fill the void with the Holy Ghost Fill the void with God. Fill the void with the Word of God. Fill the void with the power of the Holy Ghost. When God takes something, He must replace it. When God delivers you from an ungodly soul tie, He will replace it. Matthew 12:43-45 warns us not to leave empty spaces — fill the space with the Holy Ghost. God wants to restore you after breaking the soul tie. He restores your peace. He restores your identity — because you lost who you are, you lost what you were supposed to be, you lost your way, you lost confidence. When you break this ungodly soul tie, you restore your identity. You restore your emotional stability. You restore your spiritual strength again. You become you again. You begin to wake up again. You begin to feel yourself again. You will no longer be controlled. Step 7 — Be joined to Christ You are joined to Christ — the strongest and the most important soul tie. When you are connected to Jesus, you receive life. You receive freedom. You receive your identity back. You receive your power back, your potential. You receive your career back. You receive your confidence. And we honour our God in connection with Christ, so that the connection with God grows stronger and stronger by the power of the Holy Spirit. The prophetic direction given with these steps Pastor Kiky directed the room to take communion wine, and to write on a piece of paper the names of any attachments or ungodly soul ties they knew they had — the ones the Holy Spirit brought to mind, maybe three or five — then to renounce and denounce every connection, every attachment, every covenant, out loud. The communion wine is the blood of Jesus, and the blood is a new covenant: it is Christ's finished work that breaks the tie, never the paper and never the wine in itself. Afterwards, the direction was to rip that paper into pieces and flush it out of your life, saying: “I remove you. I disconnect myself from you.” And to practise it — not just once, but as many times as needed until you know you are completely free.

entries.title: Module 7 — Seven Steps to Break Ungodly Soul Ties
entries.text: Lord, separate me spiritually from this person — mention their name. Lord, disconnect me from this person — mention their name. Lord, detach me, in the name of Jesus, by the blood.

entries.title: Module 7 — Seven Steps to Break Ungodly Soul Ties
entries.text: I renounce every ungodly soul tie.

entries.title: Module 7 — Seven Steps to Break Ungodly Soul Ties
entries.text: I renounce and denounce any connection and relationship with these people.

entries.title: Module 7 — Seven Steps to Break Ungodly Soul Ties
entries.text: I destroy any blood covenant I had with these people.

entries.title: Module 7 — Seven Steps to Break Ungodly Soul Ties
entries.text: I declare total separation from every ungodly soul tie, in the name of Jesus.

entries.title: Module 7 — Seven Steps to Break Ungodly Soul Ties
entries.text: I remove you. I disconnect myself from you. As I flush this paper, these names, I flush it out of my life, out of my spirit, out of my soul, out of my body, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.title: Module 7 — Seven Steps to Break Ungodly Soul Ties
entries.text: What is step one, and why does it come first? Repentance — repenting for any involvement, so that the sins are blotted out and the times of refreshing come from the presence of the Lord.

entries.title: Module 7 — Seven Steps to Break Ungodly Soul Ties
entries.text: What did Pastor Kiky mean by “your freedom is voice-activated”? That renouncing and denouncing must be spoken out loud; when you begin to speak and rebuke by the power of the Holy Ghost, the bond is broken.

entries.title: Module 7 — Seven Steps to Break Ungodly Soul Ties
entries.text: Why must the void be filled after deliverance? Because Matthew 12:43-45 warns that an empty, swept house invites the unclean spirit back with seven others more wicked. The space must be filled with the Holy Ghost and the Word of God.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: God is the Father of open doors. What the ungodly tie shut, He opens; what was stolen, He returns; and favour surrounds the delivered believer as a shield. As the covenant breaks, the blessings of the Lord and the Spirit of the Lord are invited to dwell inside you. Pastor Kiky stood on the word of the Lord and declared that God is the Father of open doors — the Father who opens the doors and no man can shut them. When the ungodly soul tie came, some doors were shut. So those doors are opened again: every door of blessing, every door of favour, every door of opportunity that has been shut because of evil. Every power standing at the gates of a breakthrough, and every force delaying a lifting, is destroyed. Every spiritual embargo placed upon a destiny is destroyed. Every ancient gate, every stubborn door resisting progress, is lifted up by the power of the Holy Spirit. Restored identity, returned virtues Whatever has been stolen — blessings, career, virtue, beauty — returns. Every glory, every identity that has been withdrawn from a life returns, in every area. They took the identity. They took the blessing. They took the favour. Let it return, by the power of the Holy Ghost. And the Lord surrounds the believer with favour as a shield. Let men and women go out of their way to bless you. Whoever has taken the blessing from you — let it be returned. Anointing with oil The room was directed to take anointing oil and to anoint the head while declaring the open doors. The oil carries no power of its own; it is a point of contact for faith in what Christ has already finished, and the doors open because God is the one who opens them and no man can shut them. The word over the room Your prayer at the altar of God shall be answered. Whatever was your request, whatever you are asking God for — it will come to pass. Your season of delay is over. Enter into your door of breakthrough now. You shall not be denied. God will open for you. Whatever has been taken from you, whatever was snatched from you, is returning by the power of the Holy Ghost. Prayers for your children, let it be answered. Prayers over your marriages, let it be answered. All that you have asked for, let it come to pass. You will testify of the glory of the Lord.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Father, every door of blessing, every door of favour, every door of opportunity that has been shut against you because of evil — let them be open right now. We open them right now. Let them be open, in Jesus' name. Amen!

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Every power standing at the gates of your breakthrough, and every force delaying your lifting — let it be destroyed right now.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Every spiritual embargo placed upon your destiny, be destroyed.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Every ancient gate, every stubborn door resisting your progress, be lifted up right now by the power of the Holy Spirit, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Every glory, every identity that has been withdrawn from your life, let it return to you. Let it return to you in every area of your life.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: The Lord surrounds you with favour as a shield right now, wherever you are. Let men and women go out of their way to bless you. Whoever has taken the blessing from you — let it be returned.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Father, open doors that no man can shut.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Doors of promotion, let it be open.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Doors of increase, let it be open.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Doors of divine connection, let it be open.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Doors of destiny, let it be open.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Doors of restoration, let it be open.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Let it be open in my life.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Because of the ungodly soul tie I have been rejected — let me be accepted, in the name of Jesus.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Where I have been delayed, let me receive speed, in the name of Jesus.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Where I have been forgotten, Lord, let me be remembered again, in the name of Jesus.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Every spirit of delay and every spirit of rejection — I break it.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: I reject every sickness in my life. I reject poor health in my life.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: From today, I will move forward. I will move forward in the name of Jesus Christ, by the power of the Holy Ghost.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: I am blessed in my home. I am blessed in my family. I am blessed in my business. I am blessed in every area of my life.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: My identity, return to me!

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: What name did Pastor Kiky give God in this segment? The Father of open doors — the Father who opens the doors and no man can shut them.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: Why does restoration belong to a soul-tie teaching? Because when the ungodly soul tie came, doors were shut and identity, blessing and favour were taken. Deliverance is followed by open doors and the return of what was stolen.

entries.title: Module 8 — Restoration and Open Doors
entries.text: How is the anointing oil to be understood? As a point of contact for faith in Christ's finished work — it has no power of its own; God opens the doors and no man can shut them.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:1 (KJV)
entries.text: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee. The call to arise is grounded not in feelings but in the risen glory of God upon the believer.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:2 (KJV)
entries.text: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee. Darkness covers the earth generally, but the glory of the Lord is a personal covering over His people.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:3 (KJV)
entries.text: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising. The delivered believer becomes a light others are drawn toward.

entries.title: Psalm 23:1 (KJV)
entries.text: (A Psalm of David.) The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. Quoted in thanksgiving — God as provider even when doors were closed and things were tight.

entries.title: Psalm 91:1 (KJV)
entries.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. Pastor Kiky used this to show the room they had been dwelling under a covering they did not see.

entries.title: Psalm 121:1 (KJV)
entries.text: (A Song of degrees.) I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. Read corporately by the room to open the heavens over the service.

entries.title: Psalm 121:2 (KJV)
entries.text: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth. Help is located in the Creator, not in circumstances or people.

entries.title: Psalm 121:3 (KJV)
entries.text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber. God's keeping is unbroken even while the believer sleeps.

entries.title: Psalm 121:4 (KJV)
entries.text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. The Keeper never rests — battles were fought while the room was resting.

entries.title: Psalm 121:5 (KJV)
entries.text: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand. God positions Himself as shade at the place of strength and action.

entries.title: Psalm 121:6 (KJV)
entries.text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night. Day and night attacks are both covered.

entries.title: Psalm 121:7 (KJV)
entries.text: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul. Preservation of the soul is directly relevant to a soul-tie teaching.

entries.title: Psalm 121:8 (KJV)
entries.text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore. The thanksgiving refrain Pastor Kiky returned to repeatedly: our going out and our coming in.

entries.kind: Scripture · Confession of Sins and Cleansing
entries.title: Isaiah 59:2 (KJV)
entries.text: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear. Pastor Kiky taught that sometimes the delay is not the devil but what has not been surrendered to God.

entries.kind: Scripture · Confession of Sins and Cleansing
entries.title: 1 John 1:9 (KJV)
entries.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. God is not looking to condemn but to forgive; His mercy is deeper than the sin.

entries.kind: Scripture · Confession of Sins and Cleansing
entries.title: Psalm 51:10 (KJV)
entries.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me. Prayed corporately during the confession segment — a clean heart and a renewed right spirit.

entries.title: Romans 8:26 (KJV)
entries.text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered. The Holy Spirit teaches what to pray, empowers the prayer, and aligns the believer with God's will.

entries.title: Isaiah 28:18 (KJV)
entries.text: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it. MAIN SCRIPTURE. Ungodly soul ties are covenants with death — and God declares they shall be disannulled.

entries.title: Galatians 3:13 (KJV)
entries.text: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree: The legal ground for breaking every ungodly covenant is the finished work of Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 3:14 (KJV)
entries.text: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith. Redemption from the curse opens the way to the blessing and the promise of the Spirit.

entries.kind: Scripture · What a Soul Tie Is
entries.title: Genesis 2:24 (KJV)
entries.text: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh. The godly pattern — a covenant bond that makes two people one flesh. This shows relationships create real spiritual connections.

entries.kind: Scripture · What a Soul Tie Is
entries.title: 1 Samuel 18:1 (KJV)
entries.text: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul. A godly friendship soul tie — proof that soul ties are real, powerful, and not always evil.

entries.kind: Scripture · What a Soul Tie Is
entries.title: 1 Corinthians 6:16 (KJV)
entries.text: What? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body? for two, saith he, shall be one flesh. Sexual contact outside God's will forms a one-flesh bond. Sex is not only physical; it is spiritual.

entries.kind: Scripture · What a Soul Tie Is
entries.title: 1 Corinthians 6:17 (KJV)
entries.text: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit. The strongest and most important soul tie — being joined to the Lord as one spirit.

entries.title: Judges 16:19 (KJV)
entries.text: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him. Samson's strength left him through the ungodly tie — 'that is why Samson lost his strength through Delilah.'

entries.title: Hosea 4:6 (KJV)
entries.text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children. Quoted at the close — hidden things fight lives, and lack of knowledge destroys. Revelation precedes deliverance.

entries.title: John 8:36 (KJV)
entries.text: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed. The good news of the teaching: freedom through the Son is real freedom, not partial freedom.

entries.title: Acts 3:19 (KJV)
entries.text: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord; Repentance blots out the sin and brings the times of refreshing — freedom begins here.

entries.title: Revelation 12:11 (KJV)
entries.text: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death. Quoted twice in the service — the blood and the spoken word together overcome. Freedom is voice-activated.

entries.kind: Scripture · Do Not Leave the House Empty
entries.title: Matthew 12:43 (KJV)
entries.text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none. The unclean spirit does not stop seeking after it is cast out.

entries.kind: Scripture · Do Not Leave the House Empty
entries.title: Matthew 12:44 (KJV)
entries.text: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished. An empty house is an invitation — deliverance must be followed by filling.

entries.kind: Scripture · Do Not Leave the House Empty
entries.title: Matthew 12:45 (KJV)
entries.text: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation. Pastor Kiky's warning: fill the space with the Holy Ghost. When God takes something, He replaces it.

entries.title: Revelation 3:8 (KJV)
entries.text: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name. God is the Father of open doors — doors He opens no man can shut.

entries.title: Psalm 5:12 (KJV)
entries.text: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield. Favour surrounds the delivered believer as a shield, replacing what the ungodly tie took.

entries.title: Psalm 23:6 (KJV)
entries.text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever. Spoken in the closing benediction over the whole room.

entries.title: 2 Corinthians 13:14 (KJV)
entries.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen. The grace shared corporately at the end of every L137 service.

entries.title: Luke 1:37 (KJV)
entries.text: For with God nothing shall be impossible. The ministry scripture — L137. The whole teaching stands on this.

entries.title: Thanksgiving
entries.text: Father, we give you thanks for our going out and our coming in.

entries.title: Thanksgiving
entries.text: We give God thanks, for He has done exceedingly, abundantly and above all for our families and our loved ones.

entries.title: Thanksgiving
entries.text: Thank you, Lord, that accidents were cancelled, evil was diverted, and death was rejected on our behalf.

entries.title: Thanksgiving
entries.text: Father, we give you thanks — for your covering has been our shield, our defence and our refuge.

entries.title: Thanksgiving
entries.text: Jesus, Son of God, who has no beginning and no end — thank you so much for what You have done in my life.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: Father, forgive me of my sins. Wash it away. Wash it away. Do not allow my sins to stand in the way of my breakthrough, in the name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: Forgive me, Lord Jesus. In any way I have sinned against you, I repent. I confess my sins in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: Every sin of disobedience, every hidden sin tonight, every sin in my thoughts, in my words, in my actions — Lord, forgive me, in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: Anything in me that is not pleasing to you, Lord, I surrender it tonight. Cleanse me. Cleanse me from every sin. Every power of sin over my life, Lord, let it be broken by the blood of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: Every habit that draws me away from you, O Lord, let it be destroyed tonight.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: I receive grace to live a righteous life. I receive strength to overcome every temptation. Sin will not have dominion over my life. Sin will not stand in the way of my breakthrough.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: Lord, cleanse me tonight. Remove every barrier to breakthrough. Let every sin standing between me and my breakthrough be removed tonight. Every spiritual blockage that is caused by sin, I command it tonight to clear away.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: Every delay that is caused by disobedience, I ask the Lord, let it be reversed tonight, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: I plead the blood of Jesus over my life. Blood of Jesus, wash me tonight. Blood of Jesus, purify my spirit. Blood of Jesus, remove every stain of sin. Let the blood speak mercy. Let the blood speak restoration. Let the blood speak deliverance.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: I pray for restoration of my joy. I pray for restoration of my life. I pray for restoration of my spiritual fire.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: Create in me a clean heart, and renew a right spirit within me, by the power of the Holy Ghost.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.title: Repentance and Confession of Sins
entries.text: Lord, forgive me of every sin tonight. Wash it with your blood. Forgive and cleanse me now, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.title: Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.text: Begin to speak in tongues by the power of the Holy Ghost.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.title: Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.text: Invite the Spirit of the Lord into this atmosphere. Invite the Spirit of the Lord in the name of Jesus. Let that Spirit lead us. Let that Spirit surround us.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.title: Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.text: In the name of Jesus, we lay down our plans, we lay down our thoughts, we lay down our wills. Let the Holy Spirit take control, in the mighty name of Jesus. Let His will be done in our life and in our destiny.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.title: Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.text: Holy Ghost, we invite you. Holy Ghost, come and have your way. Holy Spirit, lead us. Holy Spirit, take full control of us. Holy Spirit, revive us with holy fire.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.title: Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.text: Holy Ghost fire, fall upon us. Let every bondage be broken in our life. Holy Ghost fire, saturate our atmosphere.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.title: Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.text: Let nothing hinder our prayer. Let nothing hinder our deliverance. Let nothing hinder our understanding.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.title: Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.text: Release your power upon us tonight. Release your fresh anointing upon us tonight. Release your divine authority upon us tonight.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.title: Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.text: We receive power to pray. We receive power to overcome. We receive your power, Holy Spirit, to win our battles tonight.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.title: Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.text: Take over tonight. Lead us tonight. We call upon your name.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.title: Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.text: Let our prayer life catch fire. We receive fresh fire. Let the atmosphere be changed, Holy Spirit. No demon can resist the fire. We destroy every entity in our atmosphere.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.title: Inviting the Holy Spirit
entries.text: Holy Ghost, go ahead of us, in the mighty name of Jesus. Thank you, Holy Spirit. Amen.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: I plead the blood of Jesus upon your spirit. I plead the blood of Jesus upon your soul. I plead the blood of Jesus upon your body.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: I apply the blood of Jesus to break every demonic yoke in your life and in your destiny.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: May the Lord have mercy and forgive you of every sin.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: I bind every demon assigned to enforce any evil covenant in your life.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: I command the strong force behind your relationship, behind your marriage, to catch fire tonight.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: Let go of ungodly ties with your ex, with whom you had sex in the past. Somebody shout: “Break by fire!”

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: Every altar oppressing your life as a result of ungodly relationships, ungodly marriages — somebody say: “Break by fire!”

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: Let the power that is using your blood against your marriage be destroyed, by the power of the Holy Ghost.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: I break and I loose you from every collective curse.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: Blood of Jesus, break the strongholds of wickedness upon your life.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: I abandon any evil covenant in your father's house, in your mother's house.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: I withdraw your glory from any man, any woman that is using it. Someone shout: “My glory, be withdrawn right now!” Be withdrawn from any man, any woman that is using it.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: All your lost virtues — somebody say: “Come back to me!” All my lost virtues, come back to me, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: I command all foundational strongmen that were transferred to your life — let them be paralysed.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: I renounce every conscious and unconscious ungodly covenant with the dead.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: In the mighty name of Jesus, I renounce tonight every ungodly covenant binding you as a result of your sexual relations with your ex.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: I break every sexual agreement between you and any man or woman in your past, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: Every hold on your life and on your destiny by foundational idol powers — let it be destroyed tonight, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.title: Deliverance Prayers Over the Room
entries.text: Every binding of your soul to the water, to the tree, to the village — somebody shout: “Expire!”

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: By the power of the Holy Ghost, by the blood of Jesus, every ungodly soul tie in my life, break now, in the name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I disconnect myself from every past relationship that was not ordained by God.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: By the blood of Jesus, every spiritual cord tying me to my past, be cut off.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: By the blood of Jesus, I break every emotional bondage to any ungodly connection, to every covenant, to every ungodly relationship.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I am reconciled by the blood of Jesus. I drink the blood of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I release my soul from every captivity, every evil exchange, every ungodly thought, by the blood of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: By the blood of Jesus, I recover my peace. I recover my identity. I recover my virtues.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: By the power of the Holy Ghost, every invisible chain connecting me to wrong people, be sent back by the blood of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: By the blood of Jesus, I nullify every demonic agreement, knowingly or unknowingly.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: By the blood of Jesus, I break free from any toxic and manipulative relationship.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: Every spirit attached to me, I cast you out. Every ungodly soul tie, be uprooted by the blood of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I command every evil influence over my mind, over my emotions — I refuse you now by the blood of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: By the blood of Jesus, I cleanse my soul from every pollution and defilement.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: Every voice of my past speaking against my destiny, be silenced by the blood of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I break every chain of emotional dependency by the blood of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I reclaim my freedom. I walk in the power of the Holy Ghost. Every access point the enemy has into my life, I close it.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I declare total separation from every ungodly soul tie, in the name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I break free now, in the name of Jesus. From every ungodly soul tie — Lord, set me free now, in the name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: These people whose names I have written on this paper — Lord, let any covenant created, any connection I had with them in the past, be destroyed in the name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I renounce and denounce any connection and relationship with these people.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I destroy any blood covenant I had with these people.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: By the power of the Holy Ghost, as I mark myself with this blood, as I sprinkle some of this blood over them — I break every connection. I destroy every soul tie. Every connection I have with these people, in Jesus' name, by the blood of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: Any cord between the two of us, any cord between all of us — let that cord be cut off, in the name of Jesus Christ.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: Any spiritual connection I have with these people, any spiritual marriage that was formed — I renounce you in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. I disconnect myself from you by the power of the Holy Ghost.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I call upon the name of the Lord: any connection we had, any covenant we had, any friendship we had — it is destroyed. It is broken. There is nothing between the two of us any longer. I don't want any connection with you. I don't want anything to do with you, in the mighty name of Jesus, both physically and spiritually. I divorce you spiritually, in the name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: Any covenant that makes you enter into my dreams, that makes you project, that makes you follow me, monitor me spiritually — I break the covenant. I disconnect the connection. You will not be after my life anymore!

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I disconnect the spiritual link between you and I. Wherever you have taken my name, wherever you have taken my image, and you are controlling me, manipulating me spiritually — in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I break that connection. I destroy that thing that you have done, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: I separate myself. I separate my virtues. My blessings, return to me, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: You are not going to manipulate me, in the name of Jesus. Any manipulation coming from you, I destroy it right now in the name of Jesus. You will not mind-control me by the power of the Holy Spirit. If you are mind-controlling me through any ungodly soul tie, I destroy every mind control coming from you, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: Lord, separate me spiritually from this person — mention their name. Lord, disconnect me from this person — mention their name. Lord, detach me, in the name of Jesus, by the blood.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.title: Corporate Deliverance Prayer — Breaking the Soul Tie
entries.text: As I sprinkle the blood over myself, over this person, as I drink the blood — disconnect me, detach me, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: I cancel the verdict of the wicked upon your life and upon your destiny.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Every soul tie in your family background — break by fire. Any tree soul tie, let it break. Every evil soul tie with money, let it break. Amen.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: I cancel the nickname your ex gave you, by the power of the Holy Ghost — the one that you still speak, that you still carry. I cancel that nickname right now, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: As you mark yourself with the blood, I destroy every inherited covenant from your ex — the one whose name you have written — in the mighty name of Jesus. Every inherited covenant, demonic covenant, evil covenant, idol-worship covenant, water-spirit covenant, we destroy it right now.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Every exchange from your ex, from your ex-boyfriend, from your ex-friendship, binding you and her or you and him together — let it break by fire. Let it break by fire. We break it by the blood of Jesus Christ that was shed for me.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Every curse upon this whole love affair, we break it by fire.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Let the Lord deliver your soul from every trauma of your life. I pronounce you free from every possession of darkness.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Every soul tie that is attacking your marital life, that is attacking your home, that is making you meet the wrong men, the wrong women — receive deliverance now. Every delay in your life, let it be destroyed.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: I break the ungodly attachment between your soul and the spirit of your ex. I break it.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Every band that has come upon you as a result of an unbroken covenant, I command it to break.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: I renounce every unholy bond that you made. I break it right now.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Every hidden and unhidden covenant troubling your destiny, troubling your career, troubling your moving forward — let it be broken by the blood.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: I break the covenants of death. I break it right now, in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Let the blood of Jesus destroy the foundation of any evil covenant that is operating in your life.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Every spirit of your ex that is delaying the manifestation of your marriage — let it catch fire! You will marry. You will walk down the aisle, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Let the fire of the Holy Ghost consume everything in you that is not of God right now.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Let every evil effect of any demonic covenant in your life be destroyed by the power of the Holy Ghost.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.title: Breaking Covenants and Altars
entries.text: Every evil covenant that is working against you — break by fire!

entries.kind: Prayer point · Covenants With the Dead
entries.title: Covenants With the Dead
entries.text: I break every ungodly covenant between you and a dead ex, a dead ex-husband, a dead ex-wife, a dead relative. In the mighty name of Jesus, be delivered. Be delivered by the power of the Holy Ghost.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Covenants With the Dead
entries.title: Covenants With the Dead
entries.text: We break every covenant between you and the dead. Between you and the dead. In the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Covenants With the Dead
entries.title: Covenants With the Dead
entries.text: I break every covenant between you and any dead ex, dead relative, dead friendship. Sometimes it might be a friend that you have.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Covenants With the Dead
entries.title: Covenants With the Dead
entries.text: I break every ungodly covenant with evil beds. With evil beds, let it be broken right now. Wherever you are, let it be broken right now, in the name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Covenants With the Dead
entries.title: Covenants With the Dead
entries.text: I destroy every soul-tie covenant between you and any herbalist, any occultic man, any occultic pastor. I break it right now, in the name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Covenants With the Dead
entries.title: Covenants With the Dead
entries.text: You have a covenant with that demon through the relations you had. You have a covenant with that spirit that follows you. You have a covenant with that spirit, that shadow, that is always with you. You have a covenant with that demon that is coming to sleep with you. That is why, no matter how you pray, they have a legal ground to be there.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Covenants With the Dead
entries.title: Covenants With the Dead
entries.text: Covenant between you and any idol and any evil spirit — break by fire! In the name of Jesus, break by fire! Break by the power of the Holy Ghost. Break now.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Open Doors and Restoration
entries.title: Open Doors and Restoration
entries.text: Father, every door of blessing, every door of favour, every door of opportunity that has been shut against you because of evil — let them be open right now. We open them right now. Let them be open, in Jesus' name. Amen!

entries.kind: Prayer point · Open Doors and Restoration
entries.title: Open Doors and Restoration
entries.text: Every power standing at the gates of your breakthrough, and every force delaying your lifting — let it be destroyed right now.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Open Doors and Restoration
entries.title: Open Doors and Restoration
entries.text: Wherever you are, as you anoint yourself with this oil: every spiritual embargo placed upon your destiny, be destroyed.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Open Doors and Restoration
entries.title: Open Doors and Restoration
entries.text: Every ancient gate, every stubborn door resisting your progress, be lifted up right now by the power of the Holy Spirit, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Open Doors and Restoration
entries.title: Open Doors and Restoration
entries.text: Whatever has been stolen — your blessings, your career, your virtue, your beauty — let it return. Your identity — somebody shout: “My identity, return to me!” My identity, return to me, in the name of Jesus.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Open Doors and Restoration
entries.title: Open Doors and Restoration
entries.text: Every glory, every identity that has been withdrawn from your life, let it return to you. Let it return to you in every area of your life.

entries.kind: Prayer point · Open Doors and Restoration
entries.title: Open Doors and Restoration
entries.text: The Lord surrounds you with favour as a shield right now, wherever you are. Let men and women go out of their way to bless you. Whoever has taken the blessing from you — let it be returned.

entries.title: Thanksgiving After Deliverance
entries.text: Tonight, we thank you, Lord, for delivering us from the ungodly spiritual ties — the ones we knew and the ones we did not know.

entries.title: Thanksgiving After Deliverance
entries.text: Tonight, Lord, we bless your holy name, that you are here with us tonight.

entries.title: Thanksgiving After Deliverance
entries.text: You have delivered us all, O God, from these ungodly spiritual ties. O God, we bind the power of this destructive activity tonight. Lord, we break free by the blood.

entries.title: Thanksgiving After Deliverance
entries.text: Lord, as I have written these names on this paper — release me, disconnect me, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.title: Thanksgiving After Deliverance
entries.text: I remove you. I disconnect myself from you. As I flush this paper, these names, I flush it out of my life, out of my spirit, out of my soul, out of my body, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.title: Sealing and Benediction
entries.text: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the sweet fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with us now and forevermore. Surely goodness and mercy shall follow us all the days of our lives, and we shall dwell in the house of the Lord forever. Amen.

entries.title: Sealing and Benediction
entries.text: Whatever left should not return, in the mighty name of Jesus. Whatever covenant was broken, in the mighty name of Jesus, will not return to you, by the power of the Holy Ghost. Thank you, Father.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration After Confession
entries.text: I am forgiven by the blood.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration After Confession
entries.text: My sins are wiped away tonight.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration After Confession
entries.text: I am cleansed and made holy again tonight.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration After Confession
entries.text: No sin will stand against my breakthrough from tonight.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration After Confession
entries.text: I will walk in righteousness and victory.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration After Confession
entries.text: My heavens are open. My breakthrough is released over my life and over my destiny.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration After Confession
entries.text: As I have repented and cried for mercy — Lord, let every closed door be opened. Let my deliverance reach me tonight. Let every delayed blessing be released. Let every spiritual barrier be destroyed, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration After Confession
entries.text: I will walk in purity. I will walk in power. I will walk in breakthrough, by the power of the Holy Ghost.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration After Confession
entries.text: Let your blood wash me. Let your mercy stand with me, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.text: Every ungodly soul tie must break in the name of Jesus.

entries.title: Declarations Breaking the Ungodly Soul Tie
entries.text: I renounce every ungodly soul tie.

entries.kind: Declaration · Declarations Breaking the Ungodly Soul Tie

entries.text: I declare that every sexual agreement between me and any man is broken by the blood of Jesus Christ.

entries.kind: Declaration · Declarations Breaking the Ungodly Soul Tie

entries.text: I am reconciled by the blood of Jesus. I drink the blood of Jesus.

entries.title: Declarations Breaking the Ungodly Soul Tie
entries.text: I remove you. I disconnect myself from you. As I flush this paper, these names, I flush it out of my life, out of my spirit, out of my soul, out of my body, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

entries.title: Declarations of Recovery
entries.text: By the blood of Jesus, I recover my peace. I recover my identity. I recover my virtues.

entries.title: Declarations of Recovery
entries.text: My glory, be withdrawn right now!

entries.title: Declarations of Recovery
entries.text: All my lost virtues, come back to me, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.title: Declarations of Recovery
entries.text: My identity, return to me!

entries.title: Declarations of Recovery
entries.text: I separate myself. I separate my virtues. My blessings, return to me, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.title: Declarations of Recovery
entries.text: Break by fire!

entries.title: Declarations of Recovery
entries.text: Expire!

entries.title: Declarations of Freedom
entries.text: Today is your day of freedom.

entries.title: Declarations of Freedom
entries.text: Freedom from past relationships.

entries.title: Declarations of Freedom
entries.text: Freedom from the sexual encounters you had.

entries.title: Declarations of Freedom
entries.text: Freedom from toxic relationships.

entries.title: Declarations of Freedom
entries.text: Freedom from toxic friendship.

entries.title: Declarations of Freedom
entries.text: Freedom from manipulation and control.

entries.title: Declarations of Freedom
entries.text: Freedom from trauma and pain.

entries.title: Declarations of Freedom
entries.text: Freedom from spiritual covenants — they must break by faith. Break by fire!

entries.title: Declarations of Freedom
entries.text: You are not bound! You are not owned by anybody but my God! You are not supposed to be controlled! You belong to Jesus Christ of Nazareth, by the power of the Holy Spirit!

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: Father, open doors that no man can shut.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: Doors of promotion, let it be open.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: Doors of increase, let it be open.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: Doors of divine connection, let it be open.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: Doors of destiny, let it be open.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: Doors of restoration, let it be open.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: Let it be open in my life.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: Because of the ungodly soul tie I have been rejected — let me be accepted, in the name of Jesus.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: Where I have been delayed, let me receive speed, in the name of Jesus.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: Where I have been forgotten, Lord, let me be remembered again, in the name of Jesus.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: Every spirit of delay and every spirit of rejection — I break it.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: I reject every sickness in my life. I reject poor health in my life.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: From today, I will move forward. I will move forward in the name of Jesus Christ, by the power of the Holy Ghost.

entries.title: Corporate Declaration — Open Doors
entries.text: I am blessed in my home. I am blessed in my family. I am blessed in my business. I am blessed in every area of my life.

entries.title: Salvation and Rededication Prayer
entries.text: Lord Jesus, I come to you today just as I am. I confess that I am a sinner and I need you. I believe that you are the Son of God, that you died on the cross for my sins, and that God raised you from the dead. Forgive me of every sin. Wash me in your blood. Come into my heart and be my Lord and my Saviour. I renounce the devil and all his works. I renounce every ungodly connection and every ungodly covenant in my life. From today I belong to you. Write my name in the Lamb's Book of Life. Fill me with your Holy Spirit and teach me to walk with you. Thank you for saving me, in Jesus' name. Amen.

entries.title: Weekly Assignment — carry out the prophetic direction
entries.text: Take your communion wine, receiving the blood of Jesus as the new covenant that breaks every ungodly soul tie.

entries.title: Weekly Assignment — carry out the prophetic direction
entries.text: Write on a piece of paper the names of any attachments or ungodly soul ties that you know you have had — the ones the Holy Spirit brings to your mind right now. Pastor Kiky said to write maybe three or five; the rest can be written later as the Holy Spirit reminds you.

entries.title: Weekly Assignment — carry out the prophetic direction
entries.text: Out loud, renounce and denounce every connection, every attachment and every covenant with those names, in the mighty name of Jesus. Your freedom is voice-activated.

entries.title: Weekly Assignment — carry out the prophetic direction
entries.text: Pray the corporate deliverance prayer over that paper, and release your life, your potential and your virtues, cancelling every ungodly soul tie with past relationships.

entries.title: Weekly Assignment — carry out the prophetic direction
entries.text: Mark yourself with the blood, sprinkle some over the paper, and drink the blood of Jesus, entering into the new covenant.

entries.title: Weekly Assignment — carry out the prophetic direction
entries.text: Anoint your head with the anointing oil and declare the open doors — doors of promotion, increase, divine connection, destiny and restoration.

entries.title: Weekly Assignment — carry out the prophetic direction
entries.text: Afterwards, rip that paper into pieces and flush it out of your life, saying: “I remove you. I disconnect myself from you. As I flush this paper, these names, I flush it out of my life, out of my spirit, out of my soul, out of my body, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.”

entries.title: Weekly Assignment — carry out the prophetic direction
entries.text: Do not do it only once. Practise it as many times as needed until you know you are completely free.

entries.title: Weekly Assignment — carry out the prophetic direction
entries.text: If you could not write the names during the service — because you were at work, or in bed listening — you can do this afterwards, in the mighty name of Jesus.

entries.title: Weekly Assignment — carry out the prophetic direction
entries.text: If you have not sent your prayer request to the ministry WhatsApp platform, write it there; the prayer requests are taken to the mountains of the Lord in prayer.

entries.title: Homework — study review
entries.text: Write out Isaiah 28:18 in full from memory, then check it against the Scripture Library.

entries.title: Homework — study review
entries.text: In your own words, write the difference between a godly soul tie and an ungodly soul tie, using Genesis 2:24, 1 Samuel 18:1 and 1 Corinthians 6:16-17.

entries.title: Homework — study review
entries.text: List the five ways an ungodly soul tie is formed and note which ones you recognise in your own story.

entries.title: Homework — study review
entries.text: Read the nine signs in Module 4 slowly, and mark the ones that describe you. Bring each one into prayer.

entries.title: Homework — study review
entries.text: Write out the seven steps to break an ungodly soul tie in order, from memory.

entries.title: Homework — study review
entries.text: Read Matthew 12:43-45 and write one sentence on how you will fill the void — with the Word, with worship, with prayer in the Holy Ghost.

entries.title: Homework — study review
entries.text: Read the Declaration Library out loud once each day this week.

entries.title: Homework — study review
entries.text: Complete the knowledge checks on every module page and the quiz, then mark each module complete in the progress tracker.
